arabic: أَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْوَحْىِ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ فِي النَّوْمِ
translation: The commencement of the Divine Inspiration to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the form of good dreams which came true like bright daylight, and then the love of seclusion was bestowed upon him. He used to go in seclusion in the cave of Hira where he used to worship (Allah alone) continuously for many days before his desire to see his family. He would take journey food for the stay, then return to Khadija to take food again, until the Truth descended upon him while he was in the cave of Hira. The angel came to him and asked him to read, and the Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'I do not know how to read.' After being pressed three times, the angel then said: 'Read in the name of your Lord, who has created (all that exists), created man from a clot. Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned with the Inspiration, his heart beating severely, and went to Khadija and said, 'Cover me! Cover me!'

arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended."
Recite in the name of your Lord who created - Created man from a clinging substance. Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Who taught by the pen - Taught man that which he knew not.
